analysis_role: DISPLAY ONLY regional relief. Not for routing, slopes, hazards or traversability. Not in web/public/data.
vertical_reference: UNVERIFIED: file name says 'MOLAtopography_DeltaGeoid'; the FGDC metadata (.xml) says elevations 'refer to the Mars 2020 IAU Sphere with a radius of 3396190m' and that the mosaic was shifted 183.3 m vertically to align with HRSC. The two statements are not reconciled here.
nodata_policy: NaN in dem = no source data (any NoData among the 2 x 2 native cells), never filled or interpolated

semantic_resolution.note: 40 m posting (2 x 2 mean of a 20 m CTX stereo DTM); effective relief resolution is ~100 m. The 6 m texture does not imply 6 m terrain.
